messages:
erin: FYI staging DAST run failed this morning after the RBAC change to the staging agent role. CI job is erroring on scan start and it's blocking the premerge gate.

sam: ack, looking now. which job id?

erin: job 2026-03-18_03:22. here's the relevant CI log snippet:
```
ERROR 403 Forbidden: serviceAccount "dast-runner@staging" missing permission roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
at com.company.dast.Client.startScan(Client.java:87)
```

maya: we rolled the least-privilege update yesterday and scoped KMS/secret access, we must've missed the iam binding for the runner. adding this to the rollout notes.

james: can we do a short-lived grant for the pipeline while we debug? short-term fix to unblock the release.

sam: I can apply a one-off binding and set an expiry. I'll add an audit annotation. any objections?

erin: please ensure the action is auditable — include who, why, and an expiry timestamp in the audit entry. we need traceability for the SRE playbook and compliance.

audit-bot: Audit note created: audit/12345 - temporary role-binding applied by sam for serviceAccount:dast-runner@staging; reason="unblock premerge DAST after RBAC rollout"; expiry=2026-03-19T10:00:00Z

sam: command I executed (sanitized):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding dast-runner@staging \
  --member="serviceAccount:ci-pipeline@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
```

erin: thanks. please paste the audit log entry link here and who approved the temporary grant. also, follow up with a revoke step after the release.

maya: long-term: can we add a CI preflight that validates both IAM and KMS perms for the scan agent (a small health probe + test decrypt)? that would fail fast and point to remediation steps instead of flaking runs.

james: +1. I'll draft a tiny job that calls /internal/agent/health and attempts a KMS decrypt of a test ciphertext (no secrets in pipeline), and produce a clear error code if either check fails.

erin: perfect. also update the security runbook with the ephemeral-grant play (approve -> apply -> audit -> revoke) and template audit message to avoid missing fields.

sam: filed INCIDENT-4212 and linked the temp-binding audit log and CI job id. will revoke the binding on Monday after the release window.

erin: :thumbsup: after the revoke, can you post the revoke cmd and audit entry so we can close the incident?

sam: will do, thanks everyone. reopen if anything else pops up.
